sections.description: One plugin that turns WordPress into an AI-controllable site: 24 MCP tools for SEO, speed, security, GEO/AEO, schema and redirects, plus a full OAuth 2.1 server so MCP clients connect with a click.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

Full audit pass. Update reliability: the manifest cache now follows WordPress's own check cycle, so a release is picked up the moment core re-checks instead of waiting out an invisible private timer; cache lifetime cut from 6 hours to 1, and a failed lookup is retried after 5 minutes instead of an hour. Output correctness: HTML entities are now decoded across every tool, not just llms.txt, so titles no longer arrive as 'Fees & Scholarships' and Schema.org names no longer carry markup into Google's rich results. Includes the 2.0.6 fix serving /llms.txt with a 200 status instead of 404.
